hotels.hotel_name: Sri Komuravelli Mallanna Swamy Temple Guest Rooms
hotels.address: Sri Komuravelli Mallanna Swamy Temple परिसर, Komuravelli Village, Cherial Mandal, Siddipet District, Telangana - 506355, India
hotels.about: Sri Komuravelli Mallanna Swamy Temple provides basic guest rooms for devotees visiting the temple. The accommodation is managed by the temple administration and is located within the temple premises, making it the closest stay option for pilgrims. The rooms are simple and intended primarily for devotees visiting for darshan and festivals. More than 200 rooms are available, but demand is very high during Jatara and weekends. :contentReference[oaicite:1]{index=1}
hotels.check_out_time: Same day / Next morning (Temple Rules Apply)

nearest_transport.airport: Rajiv Gandhi International Airport, Hyderabad – Approximately 115 km

hotels.cancellation_policy: Rooms are allotted subject to availability. Online advance booking is generally not available; accommodation is primarily allotted on a first-come, first-served basis by the temple administration. :contentReference[oaicite:2]{index=2}
